{{Quote|You tread on unwelcome ground. I am Hunter Moon. I will feast on your screams.|Hunter Moon|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Hunter Moon''' was a mighty and powerful [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Esh-kha]] chieftain who was imprisoned on the planet [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] thousands of years before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
He resided within the [[Ancient Prison Caverns]] when he along with his kind were accidentally freed by the attack of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on [[the Tomb]]. This led to the Esh-kha attacking both the forces of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During this time, he was responsible for the capture of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Chayloss]] and intended to kill him as he felt that the taint of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side of the Force]] was affecting the Esh-kha [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] savants.

However, before he could kill the Sith, he encountered a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] citizen that had arrived within this part of the prison facility. Ultimately, he was killed in combat but before he died, he mentioned that his people would be unleashing the [[World Razer]] that would destroy their enemies.
